body:
[blocker] Close the source stream after copying

Repeated remote-file pastes can retain one filesystem handle or connection per file until resources are exhausted. `DBNResource.getAdapter(InputStream.class)` opens an `IFile.getContents()` stream, but this branch passes it to `Files.copy` without closing it; `Files.copy(InputStream, Path, ...)` does not close the supplied stream, including on failure. The copy path must close every stream it acquires on both success and failure.

_P2 · confidence 0.98 · lens pass-baseline, pass-simplicity_
